title: Unbrewed Telemetry Puzzle Attempt v1
description: One attempt at a Pro puzzle (a frozen position the visitor solves in one turn), recorded by the game server whether it was solved, failed or abandoned. An attempt is not a game: nothing here joins to games/game_seats or feeds a game count. `attempt_id` is the idempotency key. Every level is closed (additionalProperties:false) except `actions[].action`, which is the engine action JSON verbatim.

attempt_id.description: Unique per attempt, minted by the producer. Also the idempotency key: a re-post of the same id is a no-op.

puzzle_type.description: Closed on purpose: a new puzzle type arrives with a schema bump.

try_number.description: 1-based index of this try within one sitting.

actions.description: Every action of the attempt in order, the solver's and the responder's. May be empty (an attempt abandoned before the first move).

analytics_id.description: Anonymous PostHog id of a guest, or null.

account_id.description: Pseudonymous account uuid of a signed-in player, or null.

action.description: The engine action JSON verbatim (keys such as type, player, attacker, target, path, card, promptId, optionId). Deliberately free-form: the engine owns its interior, and its size is bounded by the request body limit.
